title: Spike: evaluate Hashcash PoW stamp as spam mitigation
description:
Evaluate Hashcash (RFC 2289-style X-Hashcash: header) as a mechanism to rate-limit POST spam. Assess: (1) CPU cost to compute a valid stamp at bit-difficulties 20, 24, 28; (2) verification cost at the server; (3) compatibility with standard newsreader clients (can they add the header?); (4) resistance to GPU/ASIC attacks. Artifact: docs/spam_mitigation_pow.md with benchmark data.

Acceptance:
- Benchmark data: time to compute stamp at 20/24/28 bits on a reference laptop
- Server verification time measured and documented
- Compatibility with slrn, Thunderbird documented (can they add X-Hashcash: header?)
- Conclusion: recommend adopt/reject with rationale
- No production code written (spike only)
